title: Physcion-8-O-beta-D-monoglucoside protects hepatocytes from TNF-alpha-mediated apoptosis by suppressing the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Hu, Ruoying; Chen, Zhihui; Chen, Ting; Chen, Zixin; Luo, Wenchuan; Xu, Wen; Huang, Mei; Nan, Lihong; Jia, Ru; Zhang, Yuqin; Chen, Yaping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物PMG对TNF-α介导肝细胞凋亡的保护机制，仅用分子对接简单涉及蛋白-小分子互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Physcion-8-O-beta-D-monoglucoside (PMG) is one of the active ingredients of Radix et Rhizoma Rhei, which has been used for treating liver diseases for hundreds of years in China. However, the hepatoprotective effects of PMG remain poorly understood. This study aimed to investigate the mechanism of the protection effects of PMG on tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha)-induced hepatotoxicity. We developed both in vitro and in vivo models of liver injury to assess the protective effects of PMG against TNF-alpha-induced hepatotoxicity. The in vitro model employed TNF-alpha/actinomycin D in AML-12 cells, while the in vivo model utilized intraperitoneal injection of carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) in mice. Interactions of PMG and TNFR1 (the receptor of TNF-alpha) were explored by molecular docking. AAV resuspension was administered before PMG treatment via intravenous injection to overexpress TNF-alpha in the CCl4-induced mice. The effects of PMG on liver injury were assessed using CCK-8 assay, AST/ALT level measurement, and HE staining. Cell apoptosis was detected through Hoechst staining, TUNEL staining, and the levels of cleaved caspase-3. mRNA expression of TNF-alpha and IL-6 was quantified using real-time PCR, while the related proteins were detected by Western blotting. The protein localization of TNF-alpha was visualized by immunofluorescence assays. PMG effectively protected against hepatotoxicity in vitro and in vivo by restoring cell survival, decreasing AST, ALT, and reducing apoptosis. TNF-alpha overexpression counteracted the hepatoprotective effects of PMG, ‌thereby‌ attenuating its regulatory impacts on apoptosis and the ‌dysregulation‌ of the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. ‌Notably‌, PMG ameliorated hepatotoxicity by restoring the TNF-alpha-mediated apoptosis signaling pathway, ‌supporting‌ its potential as a ‌novel therapeutic‌ for acute liver injury.
abstract_zh: 大黄素-8-O-β-D-葡萄糖苷（PMG）是大黄（Radix et Rhizoma Rhei）的活性成分之一，在中国数百年来一直用于治疗肝脏疾病。然而，PMG的保肝作用机制仍知之甚少。本研究旨在探讨PMG对肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）诱导的肝毒性的保护作用机制。我们建立了体外和体内肝损伤模型，以评估PMG对TNF-alpha诱导肝毒性的保护作用。体外模型采用TNF-alpha/放线菌素D处理AML-12细胞，而体内模型则通过腹腔注射四氯化碳（CCl4）于小鼠中建立。通过分子对接（molecular docking）探索了PMG与TNFR1（TNF-alpha的受体）之间的相互作用。在PMG治疗前，通过静脉注射给予AAV重悬液以在CCl4诱导的小鼠中过表达TNF-alpha。PMG对肝损伤的影响通过CCK-8实验、AST/ALT水平测定和HE染色进行评估。细胞凋亡通过Hoechst染色、TUNEL染色以及cleaved caspase-3水平检测。TNF-alpha和IL-6的mRNA表达通过实时PCR定量，而相关蛋白通过Western blotting检测。TNF-alpha的蛋白定位通过免疫荧光实验可视化。PMG通过恢复细胞存活、降低AST、ALT水平及减少凋亡，在体外和体内有效保护免受肝毒性。TNF-alpha过表达抵消了PMG的保肝作用，从而减弱了其对凋亡及PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路失调的调节影响。值得注意的是，PMG通过恢复TNF-alpha介导的凋亡信号通路改善了肝毒性，支持其作为急性肝损伤新型治疗药物的潜力。
